title: Merged findings
description: The findings the host merge produces from the facts bundle, the confirmer outputs and the lead's reply. Each finding is the seven finding fields plus host-owned provenance. source is the channel: tool for a bundle tool finding, a candidate a small or mid confirmer confirmed, or an answered severity_needed entry; llm for an entry of the lead's findings or a candidate the lead confirmed; host for a finding the host builds itself, a severity_needed fallback or a review.check-not-run for a candidate. candidate_id and confirmed_by are a pair. confirmed_by is one value: when dedup merges findings, the cheapest confirmer wins, small before mid before lead. Subjects are scoped to their area as '<area>:<address>', such as '.:var.retention_days', or are a file path for a path rule. The schema checks the shape; the host checks that a file-level subject is the finding's file.

confirmed_by.description: The class that confirmed the candidate. One value, never a list.

allOf.description: tool: subject required, confirmed by small or mid only, never a review.* rule, which is an llm rule.
llm: subject optional; a candidate the lead confirmed carries subject, candidate_id and confirmed_by lead.
host, review.check-not-run for a candidate: subject '<candidate rule_id>@<area>:<address>' or '<candidate rule_id>@<file>', no candidate_id.
host, any other rule: a severity_needed fallback, which keeps its candidate_id and the confirmer's class.

subject.description: '<area>:<address>', a file or directory path, or, for a host review.check-not-run, either one prefixed with the candidate's rule_id and '@'.

plain_subject.description: A subject with no rule_id prefix. Only a host review.check-not-run has one.
